headline: Last working day (Sat 11 Apr): 2,790 pieces across four stages; every stage within its normal band.
Still open: 13 active orders are past their due date.
Decide today: 13 overdue, 8 due this week.

findings.title: 13 active orders are past their due date
findings.detail: Most overdue: ORD-120 (27d, Assembly), ORD-020 (13d, Packing), ORD-055 (13d, Packing).
findings.next_step: Ask the planner for revised ship dates

findings.title: 9 orders have gone quiet while later-due orders moved past them
findings.detail: Longest idle: ORD-081 Harbor Knits (11d), ORD-066 Northwind Apparel (11d), ORD-015 UrbanThread (11d).

findings.title: All 6 active TrendCart orders have stopped moving
findings.detail: Each has been idle at least 3 working days (ORD-120 7d, ORD-020 7d, ORD-096 9d, ORD-005 16d, ORD-017 7d, ORD-082 11d). Later-due orders at the same stages are still moving, so the queue does not explain it; a shared cause (trims, approvals, payment) is more likely.

definitions.working_day: Monday to Saturday; the factory is closed on Sundays
definitions.yesterday: last working day before the business date
definitions.normal: mean of the previous 8 same-weekday working days; band = mean +/- max(1.5 x SD, 5% of mean); needs at least 3 samples
definitions.projected_finish: remaining stages x median working days per stage over completed orders (rough estimate, not a commitment)
definitions.order_status: late = past due date; at risk = due within 7 days and projected to finish after it, or idle 5+ working days while later-due orders at the same stage moved; otherwise on track
definitions.on_time_delivery: share of orders completed in the last 30 days with days_late <= 0
definitions.ranking: score (see score_reason) +10 if new since the previous briefing, -4 per extra morning already reported (max -20) unless it got worse; top 5 shown, rest counted
